title: Existing suite with insufficient coverage
context: A large test suite that passes, but nothing covers the changed behaviour.

coverage_deficit.basis: no test imports or exercises the changed module

test_flakiness.basis: two tests in this suite have mixed history

reasoning_notes: A green suite that does not touch the change is not evidence about the change. coverage_deficit at 1.0 must dominate.
This is the case where an agent most easily produces a false-confidence report.
